summary: Solid professional test suite with two tiers: BuildMatrix.Tests.ps1 provides comprehensive unit test coverage of core functions (cartesian expansion, exclude/include rules, validation), while Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates GitHub Actions structure and end-to-end integration via act. All major requirements are tested with explicit output assertions. Strengths: well-organized with clear fixture patterns, proper error path testing (missing files, oversized matrices), and verification of exact values rather than just presence. Weaknesses: missing some edge case combinations (e.g., testing both include AND exclude rules together in unit tests, multiple exclude rules), no tests for malformed JSON input, boundary conditions with empty dimensions, or order preservation. The act integration assumes fixtures (basic.json, include-exclude.json, oversize.json) and workflow loop logic exist but are not shown. Would catch most regressions for main functionality but leave some edge cases undetected.
